recipe.visualDefinition: A 1960s-style album cover featuring a warm, close-up portrait of a woman with red hair, partially obscured by the silhouette of a green-tinted cello. The composition is defined by heavy, liquid-style psychedelic typography that flows across the top and right side of the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: The green cello body acts as a mask and frame for the woman's face.
The warm brown background and hair contrast with the cool, vibrant green of the instrument.
The fluid, wavy lettering mimics the organic curves of the musical instrument.
coreInvariants: A muted, earthy color palette with one high-contrast accent color

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The woman's face is central but slightly left-aligned; the cello silhouette occupies the right third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white liquid-style title at the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left title, follows the curve of the cello down to the face, and ends at the red secondary text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with portraiture, graphics, and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and ochres (background and hair).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the green and red elements against a desaturated, earthy background.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme weight at the bottom of glyphs
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'O' and 'U' are compressed into fluid, organic shapes
Ascenders and descenders are shortened to maintain a block-like text mass
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniform psychedelic style across different scales and colors.

candidateDirections.reason: Similar heavy bottom and flared terminals

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus portrait of a woman with long red hair against a dark brown background. Overlay a semi-transparent forest green silhouette of a cello on the right side, ensuring the 'f-hole' and strings are visible.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply ultra-bold, liquid-distorted psychedelic lettering in white at the top left. Add a second block of similar lettering in bright red, positioned over the green cello silhouette on the right.

verificationChecks: Is the lettering sufficiently distorted and 'melty'?
Does the green cello silhouette act as a frame for the face?
Is the color palette restricted to 60s earth tones and vibrant accents?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the liquid distortion on text
Transparency of the green instrument overlay
Hair color of the portrait subject
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or tracklists
The exact facial features of the woman

mustAchieve: Legible but highly distorted display type
Balanced interaction between photo and graphic overlay

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not look like a standard font; it must look hand-drawn and fluid.
Check that the green overlay doesn't completely obscure the woman's eyes.
Verify the red text is high-contrast against the green background.
Confirm the overall grain and texture feel like printed cardboard.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a warm-toned portrait with a high-contrast color-blocked instrument silhouette, then overlay with heavy, liquid-distorted display type in contrasting primary colors.
